description: Create, edit, or fix Lottie/Bodymovin JSON animations for the local Skia Skottie player. Use for text-to-Lottie, SVG/logo/type animation, loaders/icons, state feedback, UI microinteractions, lower thirds, diagrams, data/stat/chart animations, product promos, scene/camera motion, visual effects, scene edits, slots/controls, and Skottie debugging.
hivemindAdaptations: Vendors the complete text-to-lottie skill package verbatim: SKILL.md (thin control plane), the full references/ library (player-contract, lottie-spec-map, design-taste, motion-taste, chapterization, svg-compatibility, and the recipe-*.md set), and the evals/ maintenance fixtures.
Upstream MIT LICENSE is bundled at the package root for attribution; no upstream content was modified.

Render/verify gate: this skill authors Lottie JSON into public/projects/<project>/<scene-N>/lottie.json and verifies in the official local Skia Skottie player. That player project (the diffusionstudio/lottie checkout) is NOT vendored here; without it an agent can author Lottie JSON from the references but cannot run the in-player verification loop the SKILL.md prescribes. Install the player with `npx skills add diffusionstudio/lottie` / clone the repo when a live render check is needed.
evals/ are upstream skill-maintenance fixtures (the SKILL.md says not to read them during normal animation work); kept for fidelity, not required for use.
